record.label: How teams exchanged and verified candidate circuits
record.statement: The teams exchanged verified solutions, reusable Lean files and reviewed idea notes in a wiki. They discussed unverified proposals at conferences. By default, the authors required a 5% cost reduction before merging a candidate. For established solutions, they also accepted a strictly lower cost with at least 20% less Lean code.
record.boundary: The authors used a separate check against the frozen specification before merging a candidate. The wiki and conference records document the teams’ exchanges.
